title: Khaitan & Co advises AdaniConneX on ₹765 crore acquisition of Madhuvanti Build Estate
description: AdaniConneX, a joint venture between Adani Enterprises Limited and EdgeConneX, has acquired a 100% stake in Madhuvanti Build Estate Limited, a company incorporated to undertake infrastructure operations, for a consideration of ₹765.25 crore.Khaitan & Co advised AdaniConneX on this acquisition.
